description: Source file implementing parsing and processing of reporting headers for network reporting, including functions for processing endpoint URLs, endpoint groups, and reporting headers within the Chromium project.

methods.name: ProcessEndpointURLString
methods.description: Parses a string into a GURL endpoint, supporting path-absolute URLs with a leading slash, and validates the URL scheme.

methods.name: ProcessEndpoint
methods.description: Processes a JSON value representing an endpoint, extracting URL, priority, and weight, and validating them.

methods.name: ProcessEndpointGroup
methods.description: Processes a JSON value representing an endpoint group, extracting group name, TTL, subdomain inclusion, and endpoints.

methods.name: ProcessEndpoint
methods.description: Processes a string representing an endpoint URL in a reporting header.

methods.name: ProcessV1Endpoint
methods.description: Processes a reporting endpoint received in a Reporting-Endpoints header, associating it with a group key.
